name: archive_inspect
description: Lists entries and sizes in a local ZIP or TAR archive without extracting it. Use when an agent needs to understand archive contents safely before selecting files to process. Scope: local filesystem only and read-only; never extracts files and returns at most 5,000 entries. Not for archive creation or extraction.

path.description: Path to a ZIP, TAR, TAR.GZ, TAR.BZ2, or TAR.XZ archive.
